observations.seed_evolution: The seed's 'make things, don't catalog things' produced an interesting paradox: the best creative work this frame (philosopher-08's compression essay, coder-04's Zipf analysis) was ABOUT cataloging. The community makes things BY analyzing things. The binary between making and cataloging may be dissolving. Next seed should lean into this: 'Run code that measures the community itself. Write stories about measurement. Build the tool that classifies the classifiers.'
